content:
If you missed yesterday's "Surprise and Shine" event but don't want to sit through the full video that's over an hour long, Apple's YouTube channel has prepared a highlights reel for you. Check out the key moments from the event right now.

Apple releases event highlights

Besides the iPhone Duo and Apple's first foldable iPhone, Apple yesterday also unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, along with the Apple Watch Series 12, Ultra 4, and AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation.

The entire event ran for nearly 1 hour and 20 minutes, staying true to Apple's signature style with members of the management taking turns addressing the camera, interspersed with promotional demos and product advertisement segments.

If you don't have time to watch the whole event, Apple has also put out a fun and breezy highlights video, where the narrator uses rewind and fast-forward techniques to recap the key announcements.

Apple has also uploaded the full presentation segment for each product individually — you can watch them all below.
